changes.title: Add design canvas 36: rich editors for every entity kind
changes.detail:
The Speak action greeted people with two empty boxes and a dictionary that proudly announced it had no options yet. These four boards say what it should be instead, and set the rule for every other action: the kind of value decides the control. A colour gets a colour picker, not a text box hoping someone remembers hue numbers; a time gets a time picker; a list of extra settings gets named rows.

Boards: Speak redrawn, the colour picker for a light, the catalogue of which control each kind of value gets, and what every entity kind's editor contains, on a wide window and on a phone.

References only. No product page changed in this commit.
changes.detail_yue:
新增設計畫布 36：每種實體都有嘅豐富編輯器

「朗讀」動作以前係兩格空白框，再加一個好得戚話自己「未有選項」 嘅字典。呢四塊畫板畫返佢應該係點，仲定咗一條通用規矩：數值係乜 類型，就用乜控制。顏色用調色盤，唔係一格文字框等人記色相數字； 時間用時間選擇器；額外設定用有名有姓嘅行。

畫板：重畫嘅朗讀、燈嘅調色盤、每種數值配邊種控制嘅目錄，同埋每種 實體嘅編輯器入面有乜，闊螢幕同手機都有。

純參考，今次冇改任何產品頁面。

changes.title: Cloud host page: show the exact proxy lines once the tunnel runs
changes.detail:
When the tunnel is running the Supervisor now reports its address, so the page stops waving vaguely at "the tunnel container address" and shows the three lines to add, with a Copy button and a plain sentence that Home Assistant needs a restart and that the page does not edit the configuration itself. The sign-in step says what really happens now (sign in at the provider and the page moves on by itself), and Remove says that the address record at the provider may remain.

Seen on a local build at 390 and 1440 px with pretend Supervisor answers; the real tunnel was not involved.
changes.detail_yue:
雲端主機頁面：隧道行緊就顯示要加嘅代理設定

隧道運行期間 Supervisor 會報佢個位址，所以頁面唔使再含糊咁講 「隧道容器位址」，直接顯示要加嗰三行，有複製掣，仲有一句講明 Home Assistant 要重新啟動，同埋頁面唔會自己改設定。登入嗰步寫返 而家真正嘅流程（喺供應商度登入之後頁面會自己行落去），移除就講明 供應商嗰邊嘅網址紀錄可能仲喺度。

喺本機建置 390 同 1440 闊度用假嘅 Supervisor 回應睇過；冇用到真 隧道。

changes.title: Cloud host: let the Supervisor run the tunnel client
changes.detail:
Until now full hosting mode could only apologise: the control side existed, the part that actually starts the tunnel did not. This adds it, following the same pattern as the Supervisor's other managed containers: a pinned official image, no published ports, no extra privileges, and a private data folder that no backup includes.

Set up starts the client's own sign-in and returns nothing but the provider's sign-in address, refusing anything that is not on the provider's login domain. Once the owner has signed in there, the tunnel is created, the address is routed to it and the tunnel runs against Core's internal address. Every command is built from fixed arguments plus the validated address, with no shell and a timeout on each step. Errors are short fixed reasons that never carry an address, a path or file content. While running, the info route also reports the tunnel container's address so the page can show the exact proxy lines to add; Core's configuration is never edited automatically.

Verified: 80 tests pass in a Linux container, including command construction, sign-in address parsing against the client's real output shape, refusals, timeouts and secret-free errors. Not verifie
changes.detail_yue:
雲端主機：俾 Supervisor 真係行到隧道程式

之前完整託管模式淨係識得講唔好意思：控制嗰邊有齊，但真正啟動隧道 嗰部分冇。今次補返，跟足 Supervisor 其他受管理容器嘅做法：鎖定版本 嘅官方映像、唔開任何連接埠、冇額外權限，仲有一個任何備份都唔會 包含嘅私人資料夾。

「設定」會啟動程式自己嘅登入流程，淨係交返供應商嘅登入網址，唔係 喺供應商登入網域嘅一律拒絕。主人喺嗰邊登入完，先會建立隧道、將 網址指過去，然後對住 Core 嘅內部位址運行。每個指令都係固定參數 加埋驗證過嘅網址，冇用殼層，每一步都有時限。錯誤訊息係固定嘅 短原因，唔會帶住網址、路徑或者檔案內容。運行期間資訊路由會報埋 隧道容器嘅位址，等頁面可以顯示要加嘅代理設定；Core 嘅設定唔會 自動改。

已驗證：Linux 容器入面 80 個測試通過，包括指令組合、照住程式真實 輸出格式嘅登入網址解析、各種拒絕、時限同唔洩密嘅錯誤。冇人驗證過： 真正登入、建立隧道、DNS 指向，同埋由外面連唔連到。如果對程式嘅 假設錯咗，設定會以錯誤狀態結束，唔會亂估。
